name: Daniele Faccio
abstract_title: Complexity-scaling in classical and quantum networks: a phenomenological approach to artificial and human consciousness
abstract: Artificial intelligence and neuromorphic computers provide a unique testbed for theories of consciousness- AI and neuromorphic computers are systems with a quantifiable phenomenology that can be used to further consciousness as a quantitative science. Why is establishing if AI can be conscious important? Leaving aside any moral or philosophical implications of this question, a key observation for theories of consciousness is that any materialist theory and also many flavours of pan or proto-panp
field: Quantum technologies, quantum imaging, analogue gravity
notable: Philip Leverhulme Prize (2015); Fellow of Royal Society of Edinburgh; Director of Research for School of Physics and Astronomy
notes: Leads the Extreme Light group. Consciousness research is on complexity scaling in quantum networks.
